notes: Every county/unlocated vector has the full literal district candidate inventory. Counties plus separately retained explicit unlocated regions must sum to each district. Illinois Chicago rows without FIPS remain unlocated only when every explicit candidate count and reported percentage is zero and a native Cook County FIPS 17031 row exists. These placeholders are not mapped, merged into Cook, or interpreted as zero participation. Overlapping town/district/state views are retained in originals, not added. A state is withheld if any declared district fails or any 2026 county equivalent is absent. FIPS joins are direct; missing FIPS permits only unique Census short/long names (ignoring case and periods only), never spelling aliases or allocated votes. For example, St Joseph matches St. Joseph, not Saint Joseph. Snapshots can differ in update time. Party totals follow native literal parties; no fusion-line reassignment.
reproduction: Extract originals/provider.tar.gz and originals/census-reference.tar.gz into separate empty directories. Run review-house-county-results.py --source-cache PROVIDER --reference-cache CENSUS --state-codes state-codes.json --output NEW_DIR --archive NEW_ZIP. Add --map to reproduce index/margins/geometry exports. Requires Python 3, requests, pyshp, pyproj and shapely; no network access.
